notes.title: Forgotten Hill First Steps is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
We promised, it took a little while more than expected, but finally the first three original Forgotten Hill games are available on Steam!

Forgotten Hill First Steps is not a simple anthology of the older games, we've upgraded some visuals and joined them together with brand new contents, new puzzles and new secrets...

Get it now and let us know what you think:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425130/Forgotten_Hill_First_Steps/

By the way, the game is also available on mobile, choose you favorite device!
